title: VMware vCenter (govc_exporter)
description: vCenter inventory and capacity from govc_exporter, VictoriaMetrics datasource.

list.name: lookback
list.label: Lookback
list.description: How far instant panels look back for the last sample. Keep above the scrape interval.

panels.title: Collectors failed

targets.expr: count(last_over_time(govc_scrape_collector_success{job=~"$job"}[$lookback]) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: Number of collectors whose last run failed.

panels.title: VM collector duration

targets.expr: max(last_over_time(govc_scrape_collector_duration_seconds{job=~"$job",collector="vm"}[$lookback]))

panels.description: The vm collector dominates the scrape time. Keep scrape_interval and scrape_timeout well above this value.

panels.title: Scrape duration

targets.expr: max(last_over_time(scrape_duration_seconds{job=~"$job"}[$lookback]))

panels.description: Full scrape duration as measured by vmagent / VictoriaMetrics.

targets.expr: min(last_over_time(up{job=~"$job"}[$lookback]))
max(last_over_time(scrape_samples_scraped{job=~"$job"}[$lookback]))
max(last_over_time(process_resident_memory_bytes{job=~"$job"}[$lookback]))

panels.title: Collector duration

targets.expr: max by (collector) (govc_scrape_collector_duration_seconds{job=~"$job"})
max(scrape_duration_seconds{job=~"$job"})
max(scrape_timeout_seconds{job=~"$job"})

panels.description: Per-collector Update() duration. If 'total scrape' approaches 'scrape timeout', scrapes start failing.
